Criminal Application (Aba) No.532/2019
Alla Rakha Abdul Gaffar .vs. State of Maharashtra through Pso P.S. Dharni,
 Tq. Dharni, Dist. Amravati.

Office Notes, Office Memoramda of Coram,
appearances, Court's orders of directions Court's or Judge's orders.
and Registrar's Orders.

Mr. N. R. Rode, A.P.P. for non applicant-State.
 Coram : V. M. Deshpande, J.
 Dated : September 18, 2019

Learned counsel for the applicant is remaining
 continuously absent after this Court (Coram: Manish Pitale,
 J.) on 02.08.2019 granted interim relief to the applicant on
 a condition that he shall make himself available to the
 investigating officer as and when required.
Today also, learned counsel for applicant is  absent.

Applicant is apprehending his arrest in connection  with Crime No.273/2019 registered with Police Station  Dharni for an offence punishable under Sections 188, 282,
273 and 328 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 26, 26  (2) (iv), 27(2) (e), 30(2) (a), 3 and 59 of the Food Safety  and Standard Act.
 Heard Mr. Rode, learned A.P.P. for non applicant-  State and also perused reply filed on behalf of investigating  officer.
As per reply, a raid was conducted on Taj Pan  Masala whereby contraband product namely; pan masala  and ghutka amounting to Rs.75,210/- was sei
According to reply, at the time of raid, applicant was present  on the spot.
However, he subsequently ran away.

Learned A.P.P. would fairly submit that after  interim order dated 02.08.2019, applicant joine  investigation and he is interrogated.
Prima facie, stock of  pan masala cannot attract the provisions of Section 328 of  the Indian Penal Code.
Since, applicant has joined the investigation, in  my view, custodial presence of applicant is not at all  necessary.
Hence, I pass the following order.
ORDER  (i) The application is allowed.

(ii) In the event of arrest in connection with Crime No.273/2019 registered with Police Station Dharni for an offence punishable under Sections 188,
282, 273 and 328 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 26, 26 (2) (iv), 27(2) (e), 30(2) (a), 3 and 59 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, applicant-Alla Rakha Abdul Gaffar be released on bail on he executing P.R. Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one solvent surety in the like amount.
(iii) The applicant shall attend Police Station as and when he is called by the investigating officer.
The application is disposed of.
